wiki.title: Noah Burroughs
wiki.extract: Noah Burroughs (born June 11, 1976) is an American Democratic Party politician and former American football player who was elected to represent New York State Assembly district 18 in the 2024 general election for the 2025–2026 term. The district includes Hempstead, Baldwin, Freeport, Lakeview, Roosevelt, and Uniondale, all in Nassau County.
